repair.content: Explicit bounded affine parameters on a closed gate domain make a continuous finite-sample objective attain a minimum. For retained gates, fold soft coefficients exactly using \(\alpha_{\rm deploy}=1+\beta(\alpha-1),\gamma_{\rm deploy}=\beta\gamma\); dropping gates still needs effect-based validation.
